name: Proxmox LXC Antigravity Remote Control
description: Google Antigravity CLI configured for headless Remote Control. Runs the persistent antigravity-cli-daemon systemd user service inside an unprivileged LXC container so you can connect to and drive autonomous agent sessions from the Antigravity Remote Control web dashboard.

notes.text: Connect via SSH as the antigravity user ('ssh antigravity@<container-ip>'), sign in with 'agy', stop with '/exit', and run 'agy remote-control start --name "<instance-name>"'.
Access the container from https://antigravity.google.com using the same Google Account, or connect directly over SSH from the Antigravity App.
Do a check of daemon status with 'agy remote-control status' and read logs with 'journalctl --user -u antigravity-cli-daemon -n 50' as the antigravity user.

The install script configures OpenSSH for the antigravity user (including AllowTcpForwarding) and writes terminal sandbox defaults to settings.json. The CT script keeps inbound SSH (TCP/22) allowed when Proxmox firewall options or LAN isolation (ANTIGRAVITY_BLOCK_LAN=yes) are enabled.
